#{type}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, address_id AS addressId, remark, order_id AS orderId, money, awards, balance, ext_money AS extMoney, pay_code AS payCode, spread_awards AS spreadAwards, type, recharge_log_id AS rechargeLogId, create_time AS createTime, message FROM user_money_record WHERE order_id >= #{orderId} ORDER BY order_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS countTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN money ELSE 0 END) AS todayMoney, COUNT(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS todayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND create_time < CURDATE() THEN money ELSE 0 END) AS yesterdayMoney, COUNT(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND create_time < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS yesterdayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN money ELSE 0 END) AS monthMoney, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS monthCount FROM user_money_record GROUP BY type
